verdict.rationale: OneDrive can be driven programmatically through the documented Microsoft Graph REST API. First-party reference docs cover addressing items by ID or path, single-call and resumable uploads, search, sharing-link creation, delta change tracking, change notifications and version history. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the tried learn.microsoft.com paths, which weakens machine-readable discoverability for agents. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
